edition_and_year.annual_2026_pages: Tables titled Cost of Living Index by City 2026 and Property Prices Index by City 2026. The checked annual pages do not match either CSV value.
edition_and_year.csv_year_field: The CSV labels both values 2026 but has no edition identifier, source URL, retrieval timestamp, or extraction lineage tying them to the annual 2026 pages.

definition_and_scale.cli: Numbeo explains the Cost of Living Index as New York City (NYC) = 100, covering consumer goods and services and excluding rent or mortgage housing costs. See numbeo_cost_indices_explained.html lines 231–236.
definition_and_scale.pir: Numbeo describes Price to Income Ratio as an apartment-purchase affordability measure. Its stated calculation assumes net family disposable income = 1.5 × average net salary and a 90 m² median apartment. See numbeo_property_indicators_explained.html lines 235–240. It is a publisher-defined ratio, not a directly observed household median price divided by measured median family income.

geography.boundary_support: The table identifies a city label only; the archived evidence does not establish boundary equivalence with the CSV population basis or model geography.

csv_extraction_lineage.reason: The intake CSV stores the two values, year and flag but no source URL, table edition, row/column citation, access date, or extraction method. Publisher value matches do not recover the original extraction path.
